name: Narodno sabranie (National Assembly)
notes: 240 seats, 52nd National Assembly (opened 30 April 2026). Who sits, their parliamentary group and constituency are from the Assembly's own open-data endpoint (parliament.bg/api/v1/coll-list-ns/bg); the start date is the day the member joined the group they are in now. Groups, not parties: DB and PP formed separate groups. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.
